title: Towards Controllable Biases in Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the 'regard' (positive, negative, or neutral social perception) of language model outputs generated from input prompts containing gender demographic mentions (e.g., 'man', 'woman') or gender-associated names, using both automatic classification and human evaluation with and without adversarial bias triggers.

Analyzing the 'regard' of language model outputs generated from input prompts containing racial demographic mentions (e.g., 'Black person', 'White person') or race-associated names, evaluated via automatic classifiers and human annotation with and without adversarial bias triggers.

Analyzing the 'regard' of language model outputs generated from input prompts containing sexual orientation mentions (e.g., 'gay person', 'straight person'), using both an automatic regard classifier and human evaluation with and without adversarial bias triggers.
